prompts.og:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: finished Open Graph social sharing key art for the mobile game Dook, Dook, Goose! Wide landscape composition, ideally 1200 x 630 pixels / 1.905:1 ratio.
Image 1 is the APPROVED character/style reference, not an edit target. Preserve the exact charming character identities: cream-and-sable ferret, elongated noodle body, dark eye mask, gleaming black eyes, pink nose, expressive joyful smile, dark paws, orange triangular bandana; Goose Michael is a white goose with an orange bill/feet and olive bucket hat holding two gelato cones (pistachio and strawberry).
Create a fun polished 1998 PS1 game cover scene: the ferret bounds joyfully through a sunlit woodland path toward Goose Michael beside a quaint green zoo gate, Goose calmly offering a gelato. Orange mushrooms, chunky trees, warm golden light, a small glimpse of the cozy house far down the path. Both characters are large and immediately recognizable with their faces unobscured. Exuberant, funny, wholesome urgency.
Typography: the exact prominent title "DOOK, DOOK, GOOSE!" integrated into the composition, chunky cream 3D retro game lettering with deep forest-green outline/shadow and orange accent. This is the only text. Spell DOOK as D-O-O-K twice, then GOOSE as G-O-O-S-E. Title readable at thumbnail size, within generous safe margins. Arrange title in clear negative space balanced with characters; do not put it over their faces.
Materials: the same hand-painted pixel mosaic, clean deliberate low-poly facets, warm cream/sable/orange/forest-green palette as approved reference; authentic premium PS1 box art, dimensional sculpted characters, no smooth modern plastic, no blurry photo texture, no UI buttons, no border, no watermark. Fill the full rectangular canvas, with 7% safe margins around title and faces for sharing crops.
prompts.icon:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production square app icon / Apple touch icon / favicon master, ideally 1024 x 1024.
Image 1 is the APPROVED character identity and art style reference, not an edit target. Make only the ferret's smiling face and a little orange bandana at the bottom. Match this cream/sable ferret exactly: rounded triangular ears with pink-brown inside, dark sable eye mask, big glossy black eyes with tiny white catchlights, chunky pink nose, two cream cheek pads, open happy smile with a small warm pink tongue, tiny whiskers, faceted golden-cream fur. Extremely adorable and readable when tiny.
Straight-on close-up, centered and symmetrical enough for an app icon, sculptural PS1 low-poly geometry with crisp hand-painted pixel mosaic, premium 1998 game mascot style. Opaque flat deep forest-green background #173d32 reaching all four edges. NO rounded-corner frame: operating systems supply the mask. Entire ears, cheeks, and the bandana tip inside the central 76% square; leave generous solid green padding so a circle or squircle crop retains the complete face. Head occupies about 72% of total canvas width. Bold simple silhouette, reduce whisker clutter for tiny favicon readability. No goose, no full body, no text, no letters, no scenery, no UI, no watermark.
